question: The radius of a roller is 56 cm and its length is 240 cm. It takes 875 complete revolutions to move once over to the level of a playground. Find the area of the playground.
solution:

Radius of roller = 56 cm

Length of roller = 240 cm

Number of revolutions = 875

**Formula Used:**

Area of playground = Curved Surface Area (C.S.A) of roller × Number of revolutions

Curved Surface Area (C.S.A) of roller = 2 × π × radius × length
